design_consequences: The dispatch is build-from-owned: one lane owns Necronomicon continuation semantics, one owns route choice and missing-capability offers, one owns the human one-interface experience, and one verifies current ResonantOS implementation seams.

The central witness is a concurrent conversation: the user continues a main task while launching a governed subagent-strategy draft and a Whisper page as isolated child runs, then switches threads and receives bounded completion or blocker notifications without context bleed.

The research must compare a single global conversation model against a shell-plus-project-plus-thread-plus-interaction-plus-run model and reject whichever cannot preserve ownership, cancellation, context, and attention.
Spellcraft is an owner boundary, not the default fallback: repeated or reusable compositions may route to Spellcraft, while one-off easy and test paths remain lighter.
